AREAS011.DAT:8:1.t: Muita gente do[01]Oeste vem aqui vender[02]suas coisas nessa[01]cidade.

AREAS011.DAT:8:2.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:2.intent: Informing the player about merchants coming from the West
AREAS011.DAT:8:2.t: Muita gente do[01]Oeste vem aqui vender[02]suas coisas nessa[01]cidade.

AREAS011.DAT:8:6.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:6.intent: Child complaining about hunger and waiting for Chino
AREAS011.DAT:8:6.t: [14][04][04]"Tô com tanta fome![01]Cadê o Chino? Espero[01]que ele volte logo!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:7.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:7.intent: Child showing off clothes received from the Wyndian Princess
AREAS011.DAT:8:7.t: [14][05][05]"Essa roupa e bonita,[01]ne?[02]Ganhei da Princesa[01]de Wyndia!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:8.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:8.intent: Child expressing hunger but insisting they wait for Chino
AREAS011.DAT:8:8.t: [14][06][06]"Tô com fome.[02]Mas ninguem pode[01]comer ate o Chino[01]voltar."

AREAS011.DAT:8:9.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:9.intent: Child commenting on Chino running around town
AREAS011.DAT:8:9.t: [14][07][07]"O Chino deve estar[01]rodando pela cidade[01]de novo.[02]Ele e muito crianca!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:10.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:10.intent: NPC explaining the Wyndian princess's charitable visit
AREAS011.DAT:8:10.t: [14][08][08]"A princesa de Wyndia[01]nos visitou faz pouco[01]tempo.[02]Ela fez uma bela[01]doacao de roupas[02]e brinquedos para[01]as criancas."

AREAS011.DAT:8:11.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:11.intent: Child explaining they are orphans and that Sister Lyta cares for them
AREAS011.DAT:8:11.t: [14][09][09]"Nenhum de nos tem[01]mais mae ou pai.[02]A Irma Lyta cuida[01]da gente agora!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:13.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:13.intent: Directing the player to Lyta for information about the princess
AREAS011.DAT:8:13.t: "Quer saber sobre a[01]princesa que veio nos[01]visitar?[02]Eu nao sei muito,[01]mas a Lyta pode saber.[02]Ela cuida dos[01]orfaos daqui.[02]Mora na casa na[01]frente do poco."

AREAS011.DAT:8:14.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:14.intent: Asking player if they want to write in their diary

AREAS011.DAT:8:15.speaker: system
AREAS011.DAT:8:15.intent: Describing an empty chest, possibly Elina's
AREAS011.DAT:8:15.risk_notes: Mencao a Elina — spoiler leve dependendo do ponto da historia; manter consistente com nome canonico.
AREAS011.DAT:8:15.t: Esta vazio...Sera que[01]e uma das caixas que[01]Elina trouxe?

AREAS011.DAT:8:16.speaker: system
AREAS011.DAT:8:16.intent: Describing a chest full of children's clothes

AREAS011.DAT:8:17.speaker: system
AREAS011.DAT:8:17.intent: Describing a chest filled with toys and snacks

AREAS011.DAT:8:18.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:18.tone_register: measured, warm but firm — Sister Lyta
AREAS011.DAT:8:18.intent: Lyta acknowledging the party's return with Chino
AREAS011.DAT:8:18.t: [0C][06][14][80]@"Vejo que voltaram...[0B]E trouxeram[01]o Chino com voces."

AREAS011.DAT:8:19.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:19.tone_register: respectful, relieved — child speaking to Sister
AREAS011.DAT:8:19.intent: Child confirming the party helped find Chino
AREAS011.DAT:8:19.t: [14][0C][0C]"Sim, Irma Lyta.[02]Essas pessoas foram[01]bondosas o bastante[01]para me ajudar."

AREAS011.DAT:8:21.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:21.intent: Lyta calling the children to eat
AREAS011.DAT:8:21.t: [0C][06][14][80]@"Muito bem, criancas.[01]Agora que estamos[01]todos aqui, vamos comer."

AREAS011.DAT:8:22.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:22.intent: Lyta inviting the party upstairs to talk

AREAS011.DAT:8:27.speaker: Nina
AREAS011.DAT:8:27.risk_notes: Nina — voz high criticality; checar registro formal-caloroso.
AREAS011.DAT:8:27.t: [0C][06][14][8D][0D]"Por favor --[01]ficariamos gratos se[01]puder nos contar algo!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:31.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:31.intent: Child confirming knowledge but hinting at a condition

AREAS011.DAT:8:32.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:32.intent: Child refusing to tell unless they play hide and seek
AREAS011.DAT:8:32.t: [0C][06][14][8E]N"Nao vou contar![02]Voce me pegou no[01]pega-pega antes.[02]Desta vez, voce tem[01]que jogar esconde-[01]esconde com a gente![02]Se achar todo mundo,[01]eu conto onde ela foi!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:33.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:33.intent: Child announcing hide and seek to the others

AREAS011.DAT:8:35.speaker: Nina
AREAS011.DAT:8:35.intent: Nina reassuring Sister and declaring determination to get info from Chino
AREAS011.DAT:8:35.risk_notes: Nina voz high criticality; trecho com mudanca de speaker inline (Nina fala dentro da fala de outro personagem via [14][C1]@). Checar coerencia de registro.
AREAS011.DAT:8:35.t: [0C][06][14][8F]M"Nao tem problema,[01]Irma.[0B] Alem disso...[02][14][C1]@Se o Chino sabe[01]o que aconteceu com[01]minha irma,[02]vou fazer o que for[01]preciso para ele[01]me contar!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:36.speaker: Nina
AREAS011.DAT:8:36.intent: Nina suggesting they go look for the children

AREAS011.DAT:8:37.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:37.intent: Older child insisting they weren't hiding, too old for hide and seek
AREAS011.DAT:8:37.t: [14][07][07]"Eu...[0B]Nao estava me[01]escondendo...[02]Eu nao jogo[01]esconde-esconde...[0B]Isso e[01]coisa de crianca."

AREAS011.DAT:8:38.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:38.intent: Child apologizing for not catching the others

AREAS011.DAT:8:39.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:39.intent: Child caught, reveals Rudd's hiding spot under the eastern wall
AREAS011.DAT:8:39.t: [14][0A][0A]"Opa! Me encontrou![02]...[0B]Tudo bem, vou[01]te dizer onde esta[01]o Rudd.[02]Ele disse que ia se[01]esconder embaixo da[01]muralha leste."

AREAS011.DAT:8:40.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:40.intent: Child reminding player where Rudd is
AREAS011.DAT:8:40.t: [14][0A][0A]"Ja achou o Rudd?[02]Ele esta a leste[01]daqui!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:41.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:41.intent: Child acknowledging they were found via Jahn's tip

AREAS011.DAT:8:42.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:42.intent: Child asking if everyone has been found yet

AREAS011.DAT:8:43.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:43.intent: Child giving hint about Modo's location north of the bridge
AREAS011.DAT:8:43.t: [14][06][06]"Viu o Modo?[02]Tente olhar ao norte[01]do topo da ponte."

AREAS011.DAT:8:44.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:44.intent: Child wondering if they should have just said to go to the inn
AREAS011.DAT:8:44.t: [14][05][05]"Conseguiu chegar[01]la?[02]Talvez eu devesse[01]ter dito pra ir na[01]estalagem, ne?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:45.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:45.intent: Child noting Chino still isn't back

AREAS011.DAT:8:46.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:46.intent: Child caught, asking if everyone is found, suggesting to go count
AREAS011.DAT:8:46.t: [14][04][04]"Me pegou![02]Ja achou todo[01]mundo?[02]Se nao tiver certo,[01]volte la[02]e conte quantos[01]ja encontrou."

AREAS011.DAT:8:47.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:47.intent: Child explaining that found children return home and there are 8 total
AREAS011.DAT:8:47.t: [14][04][04]"Quem voce encontrar[01]vai voltar pra casa.[02]Quando tiver 8 de[01]nos la, voce sabe[01]que achou todos."

AREAS011.DAT:8:48.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:48.intent: Child noting one child is still missing, guessing it's Chino
AREAS011.DAT:8:48.t: [14][0C][0C]"Hmm...Parece que[01]falta uma crianca...[0B][02]E o Chino, nao e?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:49.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:49.intent: Child saying they suspected Chino would be hardest to find
AREAS011.DAT:8:49.t: [14][0C][0C]"Eu ja suspeitava.[02][0B]Como voces sabem,[01]ele e muito bom em[01]correr e se esconder."

AREAS011.DAT:8:50.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:50.intent: Child revealing Chino said he'd hide in the cellar
AREAS011.DAT:8:50.t: [14][05][05]"O Chino? Ele disse[01]que ia se esconder no[01]porao ou algo assim."

AREAS011.DAT:8:51.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:51.intent: L character suggesting Chino may have snuck underground past the guard
AREAS011.DAT:8:51.t: [14][8C]L"E possivel que o[01]Chino tenha passado[01]pelo guarda[02]e esteja se[01]escondendo no subsolo."

AREAS011.DAT:8:53.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:53.intent: L character thanking the party for going to look for Chino
AREAS011.DAT:8:53.t: [14][8C]L"Voces vao? Oh,[01]muito obrigada![02]Boa sorte, e cuidado."

AREAS011.DAT:8:55.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:55.intent: Child expressing worry about Chino because he's their little brother
AREAS011.DAT:8:55.t: [14][04][04]"Estou preocupada com[01]o Chino...Por que?[02]Porque ele e meu[01]irmao mais novo,[01]e dai!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:56.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:56.intent: Child asking if they had fun playing hide and seek

AREAS011.DAT:8:57.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:57.intent: Child saying they got hungry again after playing
AREAS011.DAT:8:57.t: [14][06][06]"Fiquei com fome[01]de novo depois de[01]tanto brincar!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:58.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:58.intent: Child complaining that Chino went underground despite warnings, and never listens
AREAS011.DAT:8:58.t: [14][07][07]"Falaram pra nao ir[01]pro subsolo[02]porque e perigoso![02]Mas o Chino nunca[01]escuta ninguem--[02]ele age como uma[01]crianca as vezes!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:59.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:59.intent: Child explaining how Chino probably snuck past the guard
AREAS011.DAT:8:59.t: [14][0C][0C]"Tem um guarda[01]pra ninguem ir[01]pro subsolo,[02]mas o Chino deve[01]ter passado quando ele[02]foi beber agua[01]ou algo assim."

AREAS011.DAT:8:60.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:60.intent: Child revealing you can get underground from the top of the castle wall
AREAS011.DAT:8:60.t: [14][08][08]"Da pra entrar no[01]subsolo pelo[02]topo da muralha[01]do castelo, sabia?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:61.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:61.intent: Child saying they saw the guard talking to the water woman and thinks he likes her
AREAS011.DAT:8:61.t: [14][09][09]"Vi o guarda la[01]conversando com a[01]mulher da agua.[02]Acho que ele[01]gosta dela!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:64.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:64.intent: Child acknowledging a deal is a deal before sharing info

AREAS011.DAT:8:65.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:65.intent: Child beginning to tell about the princess leaving town
AREAS011.DAT:8:65.t: [0C][04][14][8E]N"Quando a Princesa--[01]falei como ela era[01]bonita?[02]Entao, quando ela[01]estava saindo da[01]cidade..."

AREAS011.DAT:8:67.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:67.intent: Child identifying Marlok the shopkeeper as one of the people with the princess
AREAS011.DAT:8:67.t: [0C][04][14][8E]N"Nao sei direito,[01]mas um deles era[02][05][02]Marlok[06], o dono[01]da loja."

AREAS011.DAT:8:68.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:68.intent: Lyta explaining who Marlok is and hinting at his Empire connections
AREAS011.DAT:8:68.risk_notes: Mencao ao Imperio — relevante narrativamente; manter tom neutro-informativo.
AREAS011.DAT:8:68.t: [0C][04][14][80]@"[05][02]Marlok[06] e um[01]comerciante que mora[01]aqui na cidade.[02]Ele tem um grande[01]sandflier proprio.[02]Dizem que ele ate[01]faz negocios com[01]o Imperio."

AREAS011.DAT:8:69.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:69.intent: Character reacting with shock that Elina was taken West/to the Empire
AREAS011.DAT:8:69.risk_notes: Reacao emocional forte; personagem nao identificado claramente — marcar npc.

AREAS011.DAT:8:71.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:71.intent: Child describing Marlok's house location and bodyguard
AREAS011.DAT:8:71.t: [0C][04][14][8E]N"O Marlok tem uma[01]casa grande bem no[01]meio da cidade.[02]Ele tem um guarda-[01]costas que fica na[01]frente dela."

AREAS011.DAT:8:73.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:73.intent: Marlok reacting with surprise to mention of Wyndian princess

AREAS011.DAT:8:74.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:74.intent: Marlok confirming he carried someone matching the description on his sandflier
AREAS011.DAT:8:74.risk_notes: Marlok tem sotaque estilizado (z por th/th, 'zee' etc.); manter adaptacao consistente em pt-BR sem sotaque nativo especifico — usar construcoes levemente afetadas.
AREAS011.DAT:8:74.t: [0C][06][14][81]A"Agora que menciona,[01]eu levei uma pessoa[01]assim[02]no meu sandflier."

AREAS011.DAT:8:75.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:75.intent: Character demanding to know what Marlok did with the princess

AREAS011.DAT:8:76.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:76.intent: Marlok denying wrongdoing, explaining he was asked to take her West
AREAS011.DAT:8:76.risk_notes: Sotaque de Marlok — manter tom afetado; 'my little birdie' = expressao carinhosa/condescendente.
AREAS011.DAT:8:76.t: [14][81]A"Nao, nao, minha[01]bichinha.[01]Ha um engano![02]Me pediram para[01]leva-la ao Oeste,[01]entende."

AREAS011.DAT:8:78.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:78.intent: Marlok insisting the Empire invited the Princess to the capital, nothing more to tell
AREAS011.DAT:8:78.t: [0C][06][14][81]A"Nao ha nada a[01]contar![02]O Imperio convidou[01]a Princesa para ir[01]a capital!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:79.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:79.intent: Character reacting with disbelief that Elina would go to the Empire's capital
AREAS011.DAT:8:79.t: [0C][05][14][10][0F]"Como assim!?[02]Por que Elina iria[01]la?[02]Que motivo ela[01]teria para ir ao[02]coracao do pais[01]inimigo!?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:80.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:80.intent: Marlok deflecting the question, hinting at something else
AREAS011.DAT:8:80.t: [0C][06][14][81]A"Voce esta[01]perguntando pra pessoa[01]errada, nao e?[02]Alem disso..."

AREAS011.DAT:8:81.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:81.intent: Marlok implying the party will want his help to find the princess
AREAS011.DAT:8:81.risk_notes: Sotaque Marlok; transicao de personagem para barganha.
AREAS011.DAT:8:81.t: [0C][06][14][81]A"Estou pensando que[01]voces vao querer[01]minha ajuda[02]para encontrar a[01]princesa, nao e?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:82.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:82.intent: Marlok suggesting the party should be more polite if they want his help
AREAS011.DAT:8:82.t: [0C][06][14][81]A"Se for assim...[02]Acho que voces[01]deveriam ser um pouco[01]mais educados, nao?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:83.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:83.intent: Marlok agreeing to help but requiring the party to do work for him first
AREAS011.DAT:8:83.risk_notes: Sotaque Marlok; momento de virada narrativa — barganha central.
AREAS011.DAT:8:83.t: [0C][06][14][81]A"Bom...[0B]Se querem[01]minha ajuda,[02]nao sou um homem[01]sem razao...[02]Mas antes de ajudar,[01]preciso que voces[01]facam um trabalho pra mim."

AREAS011.DAT:8:84.speaker: Nina
AREAS011.DAT:8:84.intent: Nina asking Marlok what he wants her to do
AREAS011.DAT:8:84.risk_notes: Nina voz high criticality; registro formal-caloroso; dirigindo-se respeitosamente a Marlok.
AREAS011.DAT:8:84.t: [0C][05][14][0F][0D]"Hmm...[0B]Sr. Marlok?[02]O que exatamente o[01]senhor quer que[0B] eu[01]faca?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:85.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:85.intent: Marlok explaining that while friends retrieve stolen items, Nina should do housework and care for him
AREAS011.DAT:8:85.risk_notes: Sotaque Marlok; cena de servitude levemente comico/constrangedor.
AREAS011.DAT:8:85.t: [0C][06][14][81]A"Hmmm?[02]Bom, ate seus amigos[01]voltarem[02]com os itens que me[01]roubaram,[02]estava pensando que[01]voce poderia fazer[01]alguns servicos aqui.[02]Sabe, cuidar da[01]casa...[01]E de mim."

AREAS011.DAT:8:86.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:86.intent: Marlok reacting with shock at the party's return
AREAS011.DAT:8:86.t: [0C][02][14][81]A"...[0B]...[0B]O que!?[02]E voces voltam,[01]assim de repente!? Heh!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:88.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:88.intent: Marlok insisting what's his is his and he has a right to get it back
AREAS011.DAT:8:88.t: [0C][02][14][81]A"Idiota![02]Por mais que eu pague,[01]o que e meu e meu![02]Tenho o direito de[01]recuperar, nao tenho?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:91.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:91.intent: Marlok assigning simpler work that requires no thinking
AREAS011.DAT:8:91.t: [0C][02][14][81]A"Muito bem, entao...[02]Desta vez, vou pedir[01]um trabalho que[02]nao exige pensar,[01]tudo bem?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:92.speaker: Nina
AREAS011.DAT:8:92.intent: Nina asking Marlok if there's something he'd like her to do
AREAS011.DAT:8:92.risk_notes: Nina voz high criticality; registro formal com calor.
AREAS011.DAT:8:92.t: [0C][05][14][0F][0D]"Com licenca,[01]Sr. Marlok?[02]Ha algo que o[01]senhor gostaria que eu fizesse?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:93.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:93.intent: Marlok asking for a shoulder massage
AREAS011.DAT:8:93.t: [0C][06][14][81]A"Veja...[02]Por enquanto, que tal[01]me dar uma massagem[01]nos ombros?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:94.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:94.intent: Marlok transitioning from shoulder massage to requesting foot massage
AREAS011.DAT:8:94.t: [14][81]A"Mmmmm...[01]Chega de ombros...[02]Agora que tal uma[01]massagem nos pes?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:95.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:95.intent: Marlok praising Nina and requesting a back massage
AREAS011.DAT:8:95.risk_notes: Sotaque Marlok; usa nome do jogador via token.
AREAS011.DAT:8:95.t: [14][81]A"Muito bem, Srta.[01][04][01]...[02]Agora que tal uma[01]massagem nas costas?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:96.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:96.intent: Marlok saying he feels better and teasing Nina about being tired
AREAS011.DAT:8:96.t: [0C][06][14][81]A"Ah....Obrigado. Me[01]sinto muito melhor.[02]E voce, Srta.[01][04][01]?[02]Um pouco cansada?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:97.speaker: Nina
AREAS011.DAT:8:97.intent: Nina somewhat reluctantly admitting she is tired
AREAS011.DAT:8:97.risk_notes: Nina voz high criticality; momento de vulnerabilidade/desconforto.

AREAS011.DAT:8:98.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:98.intent: Marlok offering Nina a massage in return, suggestively
AREAS011.DAT:8:98.t: [0C][06][14][81]A"Oh, esta, eh?[01]Entao...[02]Vou ter que te dar[01]uma [0D]massagem[0E][0F][09],[01]nao vou?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:99.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:99.intent: Character urging to help Marlok so they can leave and find Elina
AREAS011.DAT:8:99.t: [14][12][0D]"Vamos ajudar o Sr.[01]Marlok pra sair daqui[02]e procurar a Elina!"

AREAS011.DAT:8:100.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:100.intent: Marlok ordering the party to look for the thief and ask around town
AREAS011.DAT:8:100.t: [14][01][01]"Parem de perder[01]tempo e procurem[01]o ladrao![02]Comecem perguntando[01]se alguem na[02]cidade o viu."

AREAS011.DAT:8:102.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:102.intent: Marlok angrily demanding to know why they aren't chasing the thief they found
AREAS011.DAT:8:102.t: [14][01][01]"Se encontraram[01]ele, por que nao[01]estao correndo atras!?[02]Pra que acho que[01]te contratei, hein?[02]E tao dificil[01]achar bons ajudantes[01]hoje em dia..."

AREAS011.DAT:8:103.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:103.intent: Character saying the party did the right thing letting the non-thief go
AREAS011.DAT:8:103.t: [14][0F][0D]"Se aquela pessoa[01]realmente nao era[01]ladra,[02]acho que voce[01]fez certo em[01]deixa-la ir."

AREAS011.DAT:8:104.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:104.intent: Marlok giving simple new task: go to the sandflier wharf
AREAS011.DAT:8:104.t: [14][01][01]"Desta vez, vou te[01]dar um trabalho que[01]ate um macaco faz![02]Va ao cais dos[01]sandfliers, ta?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:106.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:106.intent: Marlok hinting at a reward for good work
AREAS011.DAT:8:106.t: [14][01][01]"Se fizer um bom[01]trabalho, talvez eu[01]te de algo, sim?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:107.speaker: npc
AREAS011.DAT:8:107.intent: Child wondering what's in the big box
AREAS011.DAT:8:107.t: [14][08][08][14][08][08]"Nao fica curioso[01]com o que tem na[01]caixa grande no meio?"

AREAS011.DAT:8:108.speaker: npc
